'''Amelia''' (Japanese: '''アメリア''' ''Amelia'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]''. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]] and is well-known among residents of her [[hometown]], [[Fleurrh City]]. She comes from a wealthy family who also sponsor the local [[Pokémon Showcase]].

Amelia entered the Fleurrh City Rookie Class Pokémon Showcase, hoping to win her third and final {{DL|Pokémon Showcase|Princess Key}} so she could compete for the title of {{DL|Pokémon Performer|Kalos Queen}} in the Master Class tournament.

After gathering the highest number of {{p|Rhyhorn}} during the Theme Performance, she was declared the winner of her group and advanced to the Freestyle Performance round. There, she delivered a performance along with her {{Shiny}} {{p|Dragonair}} and {{p|Espeon}}, dazzling the crowd. However, when the audience was asked to vote for the act they appreciated the most, a majority voted for {{an|Serena}}. As a result, Amelia lost the competition.

When she was leaving the Showcase theater, Amelia continued her snobbish behavior and demanded that former [[Kalos Queen]] [[Palermo]], who had observed the day's Showcase, train her. In response, Palermo reminded her that she lost to Serena because the audience members had a different opinion. She told Palermo she wanted to surpass {{an|Aria}}, and Palermo replied that complaining about the results of the Showcase isn't the best thing to do and added that it was up to Amelia to improve herself.
